text:
Eve: quick question re: sidebar regroup + deep-links. If someone lands on /org/red/workspace/7/reports/weekly, should we expand Reports and move keyboard focus to the item or only highlight it? wondering about scroll jumps.
Sam: expand + reveal + focus. screen readers need the node visible. set aria-expanded=true and aria-current on the item.
Jordan: agree but avoid sudden page scrolls. reveal, then focus with preventScroll, and call scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }) to keep viewport stable.
Clara: UX for state: deep-link should override previous manual collapse on initial navigation, but if user toggles after that, persist their preference. show a subtle toast: "Opened via link  Reports expanded" with Undo action to collapse.
Eve: breadcrumbs copy: dot separators 'Workspace  Reports  Weekly Report' and tooltip for truncated names. add aria-label for SRs.
Sam: keyboard flow to test: Tab -> left nav -> ArrowDown to group header -> RightArrow/Enter expands -> ArrowDown into items -> selected item has tabindex=-1 + focus({preventScroll:true}) -> Enter navigates. test NVDA + VoiceOver.
NavBot: created A11Y-240 "sidebar deep-link reveal + undo toast" and added to regression checklist.
Jordan: action items: (1) router hook maps path->nav open/select on mount (Sam), (2) focus+preventScroll + nearest scroll (Jordan), (3) undo toast + persist manual toggles (Clara), (4) breadcrumb copy + tooltip (Eve). I'll update Figma and attach keyboard gif in the PR.
